description: Renovate owns version updates here. Dependabot is configured for security updates only (.github/dependabot.yml), so the two never open duplicate PRs.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes ignore the weekly window and go out immediately.

customManagers.description: Apache Jena Fuseki version, tracked in two places that must move together: ARG FUSEKI_VERSION in deploy/Dockerfile and the local image tag in deploy/docker-compose.yml. Renovate raises the version; the SHA-512 in FUSEKI_SHA512 must be re-verified by hand against the Apache release before merging — Renovate cannot compute it.

packageRules.description: Batch routine Python patch/minor bumps into one reviewable PR per repo.
Major Python bumps land alone — they need a human read of the changelog.
Pin GitHub Actions to full commit SHAs; a mutable tag is a supply-chain hole.
Base image is pinned by digest on purpose — keep the digest fresh so base-OS CVEs get picked up.

Hold the base image on the floating 17-jre tag and let only the digest move. Renovate otherwise proposes retagging to a point release (17.0.20_8-jre) or to Java 25 (25.0.4_7-jre). A point-release tag stops moving, which would make the daily digest-drift check meaningless -- and that check is what catches an unpatched base image. allowedVersions filters candidate TAGS during lookup; digest updates are a separate mechanism and keep working.
Fuseki majors change the server config surface; never automate them.
